purpose: Distinguish history/initialization failure from a scan-to-scan objective that rejects an independent geometric estimate.
scope: KITTI 01 development diagnosis, not an all-sequence candidate, paper ratio, held-out or SOTA result.
reference_selection: Freeze the previously measured mapped prior + translation prior 0.03 + ground PCA + facade PCA profile. Its parameters already used KITTI development sequences; no new parameter selection here.

independent.config: Load upstream defaults, retain the default 1.0 m voxel, set max_range=120, deskew=false, max_num_threads=1; no other changes.
independent.input: Identical raw hashes to reference; preserve point order, float32 vertical correction 0.17 deg, finite XYZI, native strict 1 < range < 120 m. No pose or GT input. Internal upstream voxelization/registration remains upstream.
independent.selection: Elevation and range inherited from frozen InTEn (historically 07/00); voxel/defaults inherited upstream, no 01 tuning.

diagnostic.selection: Previously observed onset/recovery interval, plus prior healthy/failure controls; chosen before this experiment, development only.
diagnostic.native: Actual reference full-run S2S input; must reproduce its S2S output within max absolute matrix error 1e-8, otherwise intervention interpretation is invalid.
diagnostic.kiss_current: inv(K[i-1])*K[i], an independently computed current-frame estimate (requires extra registration, not a free predictor).
diagnostic.kiss_previous: inv(K[i-2])*K[i-1], previous local increment as constant-velocity prediction.
diagnostic.probe: Reuse frozen inten_facade_pca intervention_probe; candidate mode, fresh scan pair, mapping disabled; no source/binary/parameter changes.
diagnostic.interpretation: Compare seed and output local translation error and length. Improved seeds retained: investigate history/basin; improved seeds pulled off: investigate feature associations/objective. Mixed outcomes retained, not forced into one diagnosis. No hybrid production claim.

historical_kiss: Saved shared_near_range replay upstream_mechanics_elevation, 80 m / 0.205 deg: context only, not controlled comparison.
stopping_rule: One independent run, all declared controls and failures retained. No parameter sweep or production edit in this study. Commit executed evidence before numerical prose.
